definition: The finite value $S_{\infty}$ that the partial sums of a convergent series get closer and closer to; for a geometric series with $\lvert r\rvert < 1$ it is $\frac{u_{1}}{1 - r}$.
The sum $S_{n}$ of the first $n$ terms of a series: the running total so far.
A sequence or series is convergent if its terms (or its partial sums) settle on one finite value as $n \to \infty$.
A sequence or series is divergent if it does not converge: its values grow without limit or never settle on one value.
